items.title: Gemini 4 Carbon takes the MathArena crown but costs 15 times more than GPT-6.1 Sol
items.description: For the first time in a while, no OpenAI model leads the MathArena AI math benchmark. Google's Gemini 4 Carbon and Anthropic's Fable 5.2 have knocked GPT-6.1 Sol from the top, though both cost significantly more. Gemini ignored the time limit in testing and almost never gave up on a task. The article Gemini 4 Carbon takes the MathArena crown but costs 15 times more than GPT-6.1 Sol appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: Anthropic says outdated prompting habits are slowing down Claude Opus 5.5
items.description: Anthropic has made Claude Opus 5.5 the default model on all paid plans and published a guide that does away with old prompting habits. The main takeaway is to drop "think hard" and start at Medium effort. The article Anthropic says outdated prompting habits are slowing down Claude Opus 5.5 appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: OpenAI reassigns robotics researchers to other teams as general-purpose models might make specialized robotics AI unnecessary
items.description: OpenAI is dissolving its standalone robotics team for the second time, but not because it lacks data. General-purpose models like GPT-6 Astra can apparently control robots directly, making a dedicated unit unnecessary. The researchers are being redistributed across other teams in what the company frames as a way to accelerate its robotics efforts. items.title: Runway's open-source Praxis-1 turns video AI into a robot controller
items.description: Runway releases its robotics model Praxis-1 with open weights and source code under the Apache 2.0 license. The model uses knowledge from video training for robot control and leads the World Action Model category on Nvidia's RoboLab-120 benchmark. It can't yet plan complex action sequences on its own, though. The article Runway's open-source Praxis-1 turns video AI into a robot controller appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: OpenAI rebuilt AI shopping from scratch with ChatGPT Wallet
items.description: OpenAI is taking a second shot at AI-powered shopping with ChatGPT Wallet after scrapping its first approach, Instant Checkout. Users register a card once and confirm each purchase through Face ID or a fingerprint, while actual card details stay hidden behind payment tokens. items.title: Banks bar Chinese and Hong Kong investors from Anthropic IPO over US export controls
items.description: Chinese investors are shut out of Anthropic's IPO, Bloomberg reports. Banks are rejecting buy orders from mainland China and Hong Kong, citing U.S. export control rules known as ITAR. Similar restrictions applied during SpaceX's IPO, and Anthropic's products aren't available in either region anyway.
